title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-18
ranking_explanation: Repositories were ranked by the stars-today counts shown on GitHub Trending at capture time, then corroborated with GitHub REST repository metadata and default-branch commits. This is a point-in-time Trending ranking, not an independently reconstructed exact 24-hour event log.
global_caveat: Trending gains and totals are point-in-time GitHub signals and may change. No prior-window evidence was collected, so no Notable Shifts section is claimed. README enrichment was checked for the five repositories named in Sources and Method; no DeepWiki enrichment was used.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily GitHub Trending snapshot captured 2026-11-18 01:40 UTC; date range 2026-11-17 through 2026-11-18. Ranked by daily Trending star gains.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Coding-agent workflows dominate this snapshot: reusable agent skills, review/security automation, and human-in-the-loop tools account for much of the strongest momentum. The spread into agent-facing office software and app interaction protocols suggests developers are also building the product surfaces around agents, not just the agents themselves.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: A composable skills framework and software-development methodology for coding agents, guiding work from specification and design through test-driven implementation and review.
sections.why_notable: Largest daily gain in this sample; its README describes a workflow-oriented framework that installs across multiple coding-agent harnesses.
sections.unique_caveat: Latest push predates this snapshot (2026-11-03); the star surge may reflect renewed discovery rather than a same-day release.

sections.title: dream-num/univer
sections.description: An extensible Office SDK for embedding spreadsheet and document editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing in products and agent workflows.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain and a strong example of agent-adjacent application infrastructure: an embeddable office surface rather than another agent framework.

sections.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
sections.description: An event-based protocol for connecting AI agents to user-facing applications.
sections.why_notable: Its README emphasizes a bi-directional typed event stream for agent updates, shared state, tool calls, and human interaction across frameworks and clients.

sections.title: google-research/paper-orchestra
sections.description: A multi-agent framework for automating AI research-paper writing.
sections.why_notable: A strong daily mover despite a smaller total star base, representing multi-agent orchestration applied to research production.
sections.unique_caveat: Latest push was 2026-11-15, not the snapshot date; the daily Trending gain alone does not identify the cause of the attention.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for authorized bug hunting and red-team work, with vulnerability-specific workflows and reporting practices.
sections.why_notable: The README details a large skill collection, vulnerability patterns, scope discipline, evidence hygiene, and reporting; a security-focused counterpart to general coding-agent frameworks.
sections.unique_caveat: Security-testing skills should be used only within authorized scope; README's counts and capabilities are project claims.

sections.title: affaan-m/ECC
sections.description: An agent-harness optimization project spanning skills, memory, security, and research-first development.
sections.why_notable: Cross-harness positioning and a substantial daily gain reinforce demand for reusable coding-agent tooling rather than single-model workflows.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: An AI-assisted code-review tool combining deterministic checks with an LLM agent and line-level feedback.
sections.why_notable: Its README describes contextual diff review, tool use, and scanning beyond changed lines; an enterprise-oriented quality and security signal.
sections.unique_caveat: Performance and deployment-scale statements are project claims in its README.

sections.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
sections.description: An agent skill that researches a topic across social, video, forum, prediction-market, and web sources, then synthesizes a grounded summary.
sections.why_notable: It brings cross-source research and synthesis into the same agent-skill distribution pattern prominent elsewhere in today's list.

sections.title: backnotprop/plannotator
sections.description: A workspace for shaping plans, annotating and reviewing code, and sending feedback to coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Its focus on review and feedback loops puts human oversight into the coding-agent workflow, complementing automated implementation skills.

sections.title: getarcaneapp/arcane
sections.description: A user-oriented interface for managing Docker environments.
sections.why_notable: A non-agent counterpoint showing continued interest in accessible Docker management and developer infrastructure.
sections.unique_caveat: The short description is broad; the report does not infer specific management features beyond the repository's stated purpose.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent workflows and reusable skills: obra/superpowers, affaan-m/ECC, mvanhorn/last30days-skill, and backnotprop/plannotator package methods, skills, research, or feedback loops around coding agents. Agent integration and user-facing software: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui standardizes agent-to-app interaction, while dream-num/univer brings editable office capabilities into products and agent workflows. AI-assisted code quality and security: alibaba/open-code-review and elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter bring LLMs into review and security workflows. Multi-agent research: google-research/paper-orchestra applies orchestration to paper writing. Developer infrastructure: getarcaneapp/arcane is a non-agent counterpoint. Languages in the ten listed repositories: TypeScript 3, Python 3, Go 2, Shell 1, JavaScript 1. This is a small momentum-ranked sample, not a GitHub-wide language distribution.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is the packaging of agent capabilities into repeatable workflows: skills, review systems, security processes, and explicit human feedback are drawing attention alongside core agent protocols. At the same time, Univer and AG-UI point toward a next layer of agent-ready applications and interfaces. The list is not purely an AI wave—Docker management remains a visible developer-tooling counterpoint.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured at 2026-11-18 01:40 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository metadata and default-branch commit endpoints for each listed repository; current README files reviewed for obra/superpowers, dream-num/univer, ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui, elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter, and alibaba/open-code-review. Daily gains are the counts displayed by GitHub Trending at capture time, not independently reconstructed exact 24-hour event logs. No prior-window comparison was used.
